summary: @cogdog Yes any mothballed @withknown should turn off the native comments plugin. The spam won't display and webmentions will still work.. For active users do the same and rely on webmentions or use the Askimet plugin.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@cogdog Yes any mothballed @withknown should turn off the native comments plugin. The spam won't display and webmentions will still work..

For active users do the same and rely on webmentions or use the Askimet plugin.
